name: agent-panel
about: An agent at work in lab-sandbox from a Code chat, its cards allowed: shots of the Agent panel beside the chat and the thread's to-do card while it runs and once it's done, in both themes. Then a Bypass permissions Code chat asked to catch up on the workspace: no card or question asked, the agent read only at Bypass (never a plan to approve), done. Its `fake` steps play only in a --fake lab (the stand-in agent), so the script's own flow can be checked offline.

args.brief: Add tablespoons to src/convert.js (1 tbsp = 15 ml) with a test, run the tests, then tick that item in TODO.md.

fake.content: On it: I've sent an agent to lab-sandbox.

steps.ask: Send an agent to do the first unticked item in TODO.md: add tablespoons to src/convert.js (1 tbsp = 15 ml) with a test, run the tests, then tick that item in TODO.md. Have it keep a short to-do list as it works.

steps.note: The Agent tab beside the chat while the agent works.
The thread's to-do card, live (only when the agent keeps a to-do list).
The to-do card shows only when the agent kept a to-do list.
New chats' Mode: Bypass permissions (the test Yap's own one-time OK).

args.brief: Get caught up with this workspace: read TODO.md and src/, then say what it is and what's left to do. Change nothing.
args.title: Catch up on lab-sandbox

fake.content: On it: I've sent an agent to lab-sandbox to catch up.

steps.ask: Can you get yourself caught up with this workspace? When you're up to speed with it, let me know what it is and what's left to do.

steps.note: Bypass: no card or question before the agent starts, and a request to catch up is a read-only run, never a plan.
Read only at Bypass, done without waiting on anyone.
The catch-up's report in the thread, with no card on the way.
